title: Late Breaking Results: Encoder-Decoder Generative Diffusion Transformer Towards Push-Button Analog IC Sizing
problem: Analog IC sizing relies on time-consuming optimization-based methods that lack scalability and generalization to unseen performance targets.
motivation: Automated analog circuit design is bottleneck in chip design; fast, generalizable sizing solutions are needed.
method: Encoder-decoder diffusion transformer (attention-based generative model) solves inverse analog sizing problem by sampling accurate solutions at push-button speed, trained on performance targets to generalize beyond training set.
key_novelty: Generative diffusion models with encoder-decoder transformer backbone for fast analog IC sizing with superior generalization.
contributions: Push-button speed analog IC sizing vs time-consuming optimization methods
Generative model approach to inverse sizing problem
Higher generalization to performance targets unseen during training
Outperforms recent deep learning-based sizing techniques
limitations: Late-breaking work; limited evaluation details provided.
primary_theme: Generative diffusion transformer for automated analog IC sizing
